segments.name: sports teams
segments.description: Owns and operates the Knicks and Rangers franchises, two development league teams and a training center, earning from tickets, sponsorships and media rights.
segments.evidence: The Company operates and reports financial information in one segment.

revenueModel.text: Fans buy tickets and suites, partners buy sponsorships and merchandise, and the NBA, NHL and MSG Networks pay media rights fees.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company receives a pro-rata share of fees related to the NBA's and NHL's national and international media rights agreements, which provide a significant recurring revenue stream for the Company.
